CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   B. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.

2. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Weaving.
   B. Damage equipment used for Weaving.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Weaving.
   D. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

4. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

6. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   B. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.
   C. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.

7. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.

9. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   B. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

11. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

12. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain String Musical Instruments and Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Collage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Volleyball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and Pattern Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. C — Red, blue, and yellow
